title: Allah is My Lord and Creator
summary: At this age, the child learns through tangible things. Introduce him to Allah through what he sees: «Who created the bird that flies? Who created the moon? Who created Mama and Baba? — Allah.» Repeat the beloved phrase, «Allah created us, and Allah is Generous.» Do not introduce abstract details; it is enough for the child to connect everything beautiful to Allah as its Creator, so the first seed is planted in his heart: that he has a Great Lord who created everything.
try_this: This week: Play the game «Who created this?» with your child—point to something beautiful, and he answers, «Allah,» then you both say together, «Allahu Akbar.»
reflection_prompts: How can you use your child’s curiosity about the things around him to introduce him to Allah, the Creator?
What simple phrase of faith do you love for your child to repeat daily?
